summary: A network scan was detected on host-01 at 19:20:00Z, which is consistent with reconnaissance activity.

sequence.description: A network scan was observed on host-01.

findings.statement: A network scan event was flagged on host-01.

recommendations: Investigate the source of the network scan on host-01 to determine if it is authorized or malicious. Why: The event fx-041 indicates a network scan, which is a common precursor to attacks. Identifying the source helps in assessing the threat. Less disruptive option: Monitor host-01 for further suspicious activity without immediate blocking.
risk_justification: The risk score of 29 (low) is justified by the single reconnaissance event without evidence of exploitation or data exfiltration.
uncertainty: The source IP address of the scan is not provided in the event. (would be settled by: Network flow logs or firewall logs that record the source IP of the scan.) It is unclear if the scan was part of a larger attack or a standalone event. (would be settled by: Correlated events from other hosts or time periods to identify patterns.) Limitations: The analysis is based on a single event, which limits the ability to determine the full scope of the incident. No user or specific IP information is available, which restricts the ability to identify the actor.
